title: Norwegian Walnut Lasagna
description: A gluten-free twist on the classic Italian dish, featuring nutty Norwegian walnuts and yummy flavors.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté chopped Norwegian walnuts in a little oil until nutty and fragrant.
In a separate saucepan, make yummy Bechamel sauce by melting butter, then whisking in flour and milk.
Stir in shredded Nutty Gruyère Cheese until melted and smooth.
Combine cooked lasagna noodles, sautéed Norwegian walnuts, and yummy Bechamel sauce.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with remaining Nutty Gruyère Cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped Fresh Parsley and serve hot.
